ticket.subject: Re: Request for a copy of my personal data
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

Following up: it has now been 25 days since my access request, and I have not received anything. The legal deadline is in 5 days.

Owen Marchetti

On Thu, 27 Aug 2026 at 18:32, Sam Ortega (Support) wrote:
> This is an automatic confirmation. We have received your request and will
> reply as soon as possible. Your reference is REQ-2213.

> On Wed, 26 Aug 2026 at 17:25, Owen Marchetti wrote:
>> Under GDPR Article 15 I request a copy of all personal data you hold about
>> me, the purposes of the processing, and the recipients you have shared it
>> with. Please reply to this address.

label_notes: thread_quoted: an overdue data access request with the legal deadline at risk = privacy P2; 5 days left = medium.
